title: MCP stdio wire envelope (JSON-RPC 2.0)
description: Wire format for the stdio MCP candidate server (IFC-06 mcp / [DA-02]). Standard MCP framing: JSON-RPC 2.0 requests carry method (initialize / notifications:initialized / tools:list / tools:call) and MAY carry id (absent on notifications, no reply); responses carry result or error. The schema cannot express the result-xor-error exclusivity inside the supported keyword subset -- the server never emits both (enforced in mcp_adapter code, see description of the response branch). The legacy direct-invocation compat form (tool name as method) is outside this schema's scope and is documented in INTERFACE_CONTRACTS IFC-06. One envelope per line on stdio; diagnostics never mix into stdout.

id.description: Request id; absent for notifications. JSON-RPC allows string or integer ids -- the union type is outside the supported schema subset, so no type constraint is applied here (the adapter accepts both). Responses echo the request id.

method.description: Standard MCP methods served by the candidate server.

params.description: initialize: protocolVersion plus client info/capabilities. tools/call: name (next/submit/status/read_artifact) and the tool's own arguments. tools:list and notifications may omit params.

result.description: Response success payload (responses only; never emitted together with error).

error.description: Response failure object (responses only): JSON-RPC reserved codes plus -32601 for unknown method.

oneOf.description: Request or notification: carries method; id absent on notifications.
Response: carries result or error (server code enforces never both).
